ownerDescription:
Jamia Masjid Abu Bakr Al-Siddique & Community Center is a welcoming place for worship, learning, and community engagement. Named after the beloved companion of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, Abu Bakr Al-Siddique (RA), the masjid serves as a spiritual home for Muslims in the area.

The center follows the teachings of Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jamaat (Sunni Islam) and is committed to promoting authentic Islamic knowledge based on the Qur’an and Sunnah.
We offer daily prayers, Jummah services, Qur’an and Islamic classes, youth activities, and community programs that bring families together.

Our goal is to strengthen faith, encourage unity, and serve the community through education, worship, charitable initiatives, and meaningful community support.

JazakAllahu Khair, and we look forward to welcoming you to Jamia Masjid Abu Bakr Al-Siddique & Community Center.

reviews.text:
Ways to Access (prayer room)
1. Through Wesley Hall (Main Entrance)
Enter through the front main entrance of Wesley Hall.  Access is available during Collegiate hours: 7:30 AM – 5:00 PM.
2. Centennial Hall  Main campus building (Indoor Route)
Go to the 2nd floor of Centennial Hall.  Walk toward the right side and enter Manitoba Hall. Continue into Ashdown Hall (English Department). Walk to the end and enter Bryce Hall (Oral History Center). Take the last door on the right to access the skywalk to Wesley Hall. Use the elevator to go down to the Basement (B level) where the mosque is located.
3. Through Leatherdale Hall (Card Access Required)
Enter Leatherdale Hall using your student card via the intercom system. Walk straight, then turn left.Take the elevator to the Basement (B level) to reach the mosque.
